q2_gaps: capacity/role "as an N" adjunct ("As an official Soviet artist, ..."), and specifically a dangling one whose understood subject is the possessor inside the matrix subject rather than the matrix subject itself
a fusable compound kind with two stacked adjectival modifiers ("official" + "Soviet" + "artist") - the compound rule covers one modifier plus head noun and says to decompose once and stop
notes: Attaching the "as"-phrase states to the person rather than to "his work" is the only coherent reading, and Past-wrapping them from the host clause matches the appositive rule. Possession for "his work", Theme for both passive events, and the surface-form Manner adverbs (well, widely) are all correct.
